# Test Fixture Refinery Ltd - Annual Report 2021

SYNTHETIC TEST FIXTURE - NOT REAL DATA. Status: approved. Classification: internal.

## Financial performance

The losses in 2020 were driven by unplanned downtime at the Hydrogen Generation Unit and a fall in refining margin.
The net loss in 2021 was due to high maintenance cost on rotating equipment and interest cost on new borrowing.

| Year | Revenue (Rs Cr) | Net Profit (Rs Cr) | Maintenance Cost (Rs Cr) | Downtime (hours) |
|------|-----------------|--------------------|--------------------------|------------------|
| 2019 | 4300 | 150 | 265 | 320 |
| 2020 | 3900 | -120 | 290 | 410 |
| 2021 | 4050 | -85 | 300 | 380 |

## Reliability programme

A reliability programme for Unit 5 was started in 2021 to move critical rotating equipment to condition-based maintenance.
